item.title: SEC sends proposed overhaul of crypto custody rules for investment advisers to White House OIRA for review.
Standard Chartered becomes first major global bank to offer institutional bitcoin and ether spot trading through its UAE FX platform.
Singapore MAS proposes mandatory 100% liquid reserves and a ban on yield for stablecoin issuers, aligning with U.S. and EU frameworks.
EU begins MiCA 2.0 consultation targeting stablecoin reserve rules and DeFi treatment as July 1 CASP licensing transition deadline passes.
Thailand SEC advances draft rules for domestically listed spot bitcoin and ether ETFs; public comments accepted until September 20.
BlackRock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton and Goldman Sachs endorse U.S. Clarity Act, which splits crypto oversight between the SEC and CFTC.
UK government launches tokenization taskforce including BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley to advance on-chain capital markets.
SEC opens review of automatic filing pathways for novel ETFs including crypto products after a surge of exchange-filed applications.
Citigroup plans to launch institutional bitcoin custody in 2026, integrating bitcoin into existing securities safekeeping frameworks.
Deutsche Bank targets 2026 for a digital asset custody service built in partnership with Bitpanda's technology unit.
A bitcoin cold-wallet attack has expanded to 4,500 addresses with cumulative losses approaching $89 million as of August 2.
SEC proposes new operational standards for U.S. transfer agents to accommodate securities issued and settled on blockchain networks.
SEC granted a Cardano spot ETF application a 75-day accelerated review timeline, versus the 240 days required for the first bitcoin ETF.
